page_title: Pock: Widgets manager for MacBook Touch Bar

summary.name: Pock
summary.one_liner: Pock is a widgets manager that puts extra widgets, the macOS Dock, and system controls onto the MacBook Touch Bar.
use_cases: Show the macOS Dock inside the Touch Bar
Control music playback with Touch Bar gestures
See notification badges on the Touch Bar
Check weather, Wi-Fi, battery, or time on the Touch Bar
Adjust screen brightness or volume from the Touch Bar
Build a custom Touch Bar widget with PockKit
summary.what_it_does: Pock is a widgets manager for the MacBook Touch Bar. It includes six default widgets and can display the macOS Dock in the Touch Bar with badge support for notifications. Media widget supports gestures: tap to play/pause, swipe left for previous song, and swipe right for next song. It also provides an ESC button, system status items (time, Wi-Fi, battery), brightness and volume controls, and a weather forecast widget. Widgets can be repositioned from the Customize Pock menu, and settings are reached via Preferences and Manage Widgets. The page also mentions PockKit for building custom widgets.
notable: Displays the macOS Dock inside the MacBook Touch Bar with notification badges
Media gestures: tap to play/pause, swipe to change tracks
PockKit documentation for building custom widgets
caveats: Only works on MacBooks with a Touch Bar, as implied by the page's focus
Page says more widgets are coming, so the current widget set is limited
